posts.title: Football90
posts.text:
Football90 keeps you updated with the latest sports news, results, squads and more. 
 ● Watch the best moments of the match (And the day) with the Football90 stream right after they happen.

posts.title: WIKIPETS
posts.text:
WikiPets is a social platform that connect pets owners to share their experience. World wide people come to WikiPets to search for any services related to pets, Send broadcast in a range base to pets owners, Create interactive reminders, and share their own experience with others. WikiPets is the world of pets. 
 WikiPets Features: 
1-Send broadcast to around pets owners to ask questions, interact with them, and take your pet for a walk with a friend.
2-Follow friends, find for your pet a perfect mate, and adopt more pets.
3-create a profile for your pet, add daily activities, pictures and share them along with your WikiPets community.
4-Make reminders and to-do list for your pet as you go to stay notified.
5-Discover upcoming Pets events near you and get your pet socialized.
6-Find your complete guide for the nearest Pets Hospitals, Hotels, Shops, Shelters, Etc...

posts.title: THE PLACE
posts.text:
The application is focused on building the first social media plat form in the world that is concerned with finding outing places, organizing outings and make prepaid reservations for all target segments starting from 12 years old and up. 
 The combination between the social media communication between friends and the easiness of finding the best places to hang out at, will make it much easier for users for organizing their outings and go to any place and find the table is ready and the food is served, this is a new era of the e-life in the world. The many categories that will be covered under this application will make it very easy to the user to find the best deal by a click of a button. Categories like: Tourism Places, Restaurants, Cinemas, Sports, Meeting Rooms, Weddings, Kids outings, shopping spots, adult games, safaris … 
 This application will almost delete the waiting lists of people want to go out for an outing or want to reserve a chair in a theater or a soccer game, it also will have a major enhancement on the tourism business in the countries that are relying on tourism in the national income. Tourists can make their search and organize their full trip and the places they would go before even reaching the country they are going.

posts.title: Tawsili - توصيلي
posts.text:
Request a taxi with one tap and watch as it comes to you! Tawsili finds the nearest taxi around and directs it to you. You can see driver's name, photo, ratings and license plate as well as the ETA on a live map. Pay with cash, credit card or BKM Express. At the end of your trip you can rate your driver and write comments. If you want to ride with top-quality drivers and easily find taxis, download Tawsili! Having trouble hailing a cab from the street or a taxi stop? Tired of the traffic or waiting for the bus? Try Tawsili! • Go cashless It’s easy to pay with credit card! Don’t worry about getting change or stopping at an ATM. • Ride history Did you forget something in the taxi? Don’t worry, all rides are recorded. • Calculate fare You can calculate the fare between destinations. • Share your ETA You can share your route with friends and family through the app with a link to your ride. Try Tawsili! Currently in KSA !

posts.title: Build It Bigger
posts.text:
Used Gradle to build a joke-telling app that has both a free and paid version. This included factoring functionality into libraries as well as using build flavors to modularize the construction of each variant of the app. I also configured a Google Cloud Endpoints development server to supply the jokes. 
 Project contains a Java library for supplying jokes
 Project contains an Android library with an activity that displays jokes passed to it as intent extras.
 Project contains a Google Cloud Endpoints module that supplies jokes from the Java library. Project loads jokes from GCE module via an async task.
 Project contains connected tests to verify that the async task is indeed loading jokes.
 Project contains paid/free flavors. The paid flavor has no ads, and no unnecessary dependencies.
 automated unit testing gradle tasks dependency management build variants 
 Part of the Android Developer Nanodegree Program 
 GITHUB

posts.title: LocName
posts.text:
i developed first phase of this app that contained on material design implementation. 
 #Geolocation Do you live somewhere that is hard to reach? Does your street even have a name? Or maybe you don't know your way around town and need a helping hand? With the LocName address book app, you can can save all your favourite locations as short, unique names, or LocNames! Forget about long, complicated addresses and transform your current address into a short LocName that you can easily share with your friends and clients. They can then use GPS navigation to find their way to you! And so can you of course. Creating a LocName is as easy as 1,2,3: 1. Allow the app find your GPS map location (home, work, etc). 2. Give that location a short LocName and add additional details. 3. Voila! Share it with your friends so they can find their way to you! Who can benefit from LocName: 1) Anyone looking to simplify sharing their address details. 2) Expats who need away to get around their new country of residence. 3) Tourists - Save any location you would like to revisit. 
 GITHUB
